## Summary

Describe the problem and what this change does. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For documentation-only changes, review links and examples. For algorithm or performance changes, include the inputs, settings, numerical comparison, and timing method. Note any hardware-specific checks you could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Updated relevant English and Chinese documentation.
- [ ] Added attribution and license notices for any adapted code or new dependencies.
- [ ] Excluded patient data, credentials, local caches, and unintended build files.
